ends.conclusion: `kinetic` is the signed-channel average of the base terms plus the cubic and quartic atom series.

lemma links {N m p} (hk : m<N) {u v} (h : Move B N m p u v) : B.bake.Relays N m p u v := by
  refine ⟨h.ident,?_,h.step⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁,h₂⟩ := abs_le.mp h.δ
  have he := B.support.kinetic N m hk
  apply abs_le.mpr
  obtain ⟨ht,hi⟩ := (abs_le.mp <| le_sub_iff_add_le.mpr he)
  constructor <;> linarith
ends.conclusion: `links` derives the drift bound from `Move.δ` (`|u.beta - v.beta - alpha| ≤ 1`) and `Planned.kinetic` (`|alpha + slope log L| + 1 ≤ drift`).
